about: The story cast (the owner, 2026-10-23: 'each one in another suit colour, hair and eyes, each one markets a different product, like Ravit recommends'). Original animated characters, AI-labelled everywhere, no brand names or logos on the clothes, no jewellery drawn (the product is always its real photo). Each one in her own athleisure outfit after the owner's references (2026-10-23): an oversized hoodie with joggers, striped full-length leggings, a half-zip with sweatpants, a track jacket with track pants. Always long pants, plain fabric, never a logo or letters, the midriff covered. SD 1.5 reads only 77 tokens: the scene comes first, then the woman, then the outfit, and generate.py refuses a cast prompt that would be cut. The first cast lost the end of every prompt (a sports bra without its leggings came out as underwear, no scene action was read), so the sports-bra tops were replaced by covered ones.
negative: photo, realistic, text, letters, logo, print on clothes, jewelry, shorts, underwear, bikini, swimsuit, bare legs, midriff, cleavage, sexy, nsfw, latex, shiny, deformed, extra fingers, bad hands, blurry
